task_scope: Sun-compatible Stage 2 six-element extraction shared by human Gold, B0, H1, and D1

evidence_boundary.sun_role: semantic basis for the four modality classes and six extraction targets
evidence_boundary.barrientos_role: engineering discipline only: strict JSON, controlled labels, schema validation, deterministic normalization, traceability, and separation of semantic from style-equivalent differences
publicly_supported: four modality classes: obligation, prohibition, permission, definition
six targets: modality, actor, action, condition, constraint, exception
action extraction follows removal or identification of modality, condition, constraint, and exception spans
project_operational_decisions: pronoun mentions are extracted rather than silently resolved
implicit passive actors are absent, not invented
condition, constraint, and exception scope tests
Stage 3 admission rules for unresolved references
still_requires_user_decision_before_form: whether to keep a sentence-only primary track or add a hash-locked context-assisted track
the context sidecar source and provenance for the 68 context-dependent or non-independent EStG records
the German-to-English QA route or an alternative native-English primary phrase track

canonical_schema.compatibility_reason: The existing schema already separates exact evidence text from normalized values and provides unsupported_or_ambiguous for transparent status reporting.

input_contract.extraction_unit: one approved English target text with one stable sample_id
context_resolution_allowed_only_if: the antecedent is included in the formally versioned model input
the same context payload and visibility are provided to every compared method
the context source and payload hash are recorded
input_contract.human_aids: German source, Chinese gloss, and back-translation may help review the English working text but may not add a legal fact or antecedent absent from the frozen method input.

modality.representation: one clause-level label plus one or more exact trigger spans
modality.minimum_span: the smallest surface trigger sufficient to justify the label, including negation when it changes the class

actor.definition: the smallest explicit noun phrase or pronominal mention that grammatically bears or performs the norm
actor.minimum_span: exclude determiners or modifiers only when their removal does not change identity; keep coordinated actors as separate spans

action.definition: the smallest verb-centred phrase sufficient to distinguish the regulated act, including a necessary object or complement
action.minimum_span: exclude modality, conditions, constraints, and exceptions; retain particles or objects needed for identity

condition.definition: an antecedent state or event that activates or determines applicability of the norm
condition.scope_test: If removing the phrase changes whether or when the norm applies, it is a condition.
condition.minimum_span: include the condition marker and its complete governed proposition

constraint.definition: a time, quantity, manner, scope, destination, or legal-reference limit on performance after applicability is established
constraint.scope_test: If the phrase limits how, how much, where, or by when an applicable act is performed, it is a constraint.
constraint.minimum_span: include the limiting marker and the smallest complete limit

exception.definition: a carve-out that defeats or narrows a rule that would otherwise apply
exception.scope_test: If the phrase withdraws an otherwise applicable norm for a case, it is an exception.
exception.minimum_span: include the exception marker and its complete governed proposition

span_and_normalization.offset_semantics: zero-based Unicode character offsets with exclusive end, equivalent to Python source_text[start:end]
span_and_normalization.exact_span_rule: Every emitted evidence text must be a byte-for-character substring of source_text at the declared offsets.
span_and_normalization.normalized_rule: normalized is downstream matching metadata and never replaces or edits the exact evidence span.
forbidden_normalization: resolving a pronoun to an antecedent not visible in the formal input
adding an object, condition, exception, or limit from legal common knowledge

pronoun_and_reference_policy.subject_pronoun_rule: When a listed form is the explicit grammatical subject or regulated mention, extract its exact surface span as actor even if its antecedent is unresolved.
pronoun_and_reference_policy.demonstrative_determiner_rule: When this, these, or such modifies an expressed noun, extract the complete minimal noun phrase rather than the determiner alone.
pronoun_and_reference_policy.sentence_only_normalization: Use a surface-preserving normalized value such as it, they, this, these, or such; do not substitute an antecedent.
pronoun_and_reference_policy.resolved_normalization: An antecedent-normalized value is allowed only when the antecedent is part of the formally versioned visible input.

it_example.text: It may cover a shorter period if ...

implicit_and_passive_policy.passive_without_agent: Do not invent an actor. Emit actors=[] and map each expressed action with actor_id=null.
implicit_and_passive_policy.passive_with_agent: Extract the explicit by-phrase participant only when it is the performer or bearer relevant to the norm.

clause_and_coordination_policy.separate_clause_when: a segment has its own normative force, modality trigger, actor assignment, or independently evaluable legal consequence
clause_and_coordination_policy.same_clause_when: one modality scopes coordinated actors or actions that form one normative proposition
clause_and_coordination_policy.mapping_rule: Add only actor-action edges licensed by the syntax; do not assume a cross-product when scope is ambiguous.
clause_and_coordination_policy.order_rule: Add an order relation only when an exact textual cue or construction establishes order.

missing_and_uncertain_policy.missing: The element has no source span in the target clause. Use an empty array; in an H1 patch, absent=true deterministically becomes an empty array.
missing_and_uncertain_policy.uncertain: A surface mention or scope exists but its identity, reference, or boundary cannot be determined from visible input. Preserve any defensible exact span and add a controlled unsupported_or_ambiguous entry.

forbidden_inference_sources: external statutes or commentary not included in the formal input
web search or unstated world knowledge
another method's prediction except the explicit B0 record supplied to H1

method_visibility.human_gold: approved English target text and immutable review aids; semantic additions from absent context are forbidden
method_visibility.sun_rule_only: locked German text for the reconstructed modality classifier and the aligned approved English target text for phrase extraction; no LLM and no Gold
method_visibility.sun_llm_fallback: the same aligned target input, the existing B0 clause, and preregistered inference-time repair reasons; no Gold
method_visibility.direct_llm: the approved English target text and identifiers only; no B0, H1, Gold, external context, or legal knowledge

hybrid_repair_contract.metadata_replacement_required: unsupported_or_ambiguous is returned as a complete top-level replacement list so unresolved-reference status survives the merge
hybrid_repair_contract.post_merge_requirement: The complete merged record must pass canonical schema and cross-field validation; otherwise preserve B0 unchanged.

evaluation_contract.primary_phrase_metric: strict exact-span precision, recall, and F1 for actor, action, condition, constraint, and exception
shared_requirements: same target text and context visibility
evaluation_contract.unresolved_pronoun_scoring: The pronoun exact span is scored normally in Stage 2; unresolved reference status is reported separately.

required: all spans match the frozen target text
no unresolved_coreference for any actor used in participant matching
no unresolved clause boundary required by the Stage 3 adapter
stage3_admission.it_sentence_policy: A record containing actor span It with unresolved_coreference is valid and scorable in Stage 2 but is not eligible for actor-to-participant matching in Stage 3.

version_binding.rule: Prompts bind this file's SHA-256; the bundle lock binds the contract, schema, prompts, protocols, and pilot by SHA-256. Gold publication must record the same bundle ID and hashes.
